Barbier's theorem.fact: A Reuleaux triangle of width w consists of three arcs of circles of radius w. Each of these arcs has central angle π/3, so the perimeter of the Reuleaux triangle of width w is equal to half the perimeter of a circle of radius w and therefore is equal to πw.

Barbier's theorem.question: If K is a body of constant width w, then the _____ sum of K and its 180° rotation is a disk with radius w and perimeter 2πw
Barbier's theorem.fact: If K is a body of constant width w, then the Minkowski sum of K and its 180° rotation is a disk with radius w and perimeter 2πw. The Minkowski sum acts linearly on the perimeters of convex bodies, so the perimeter of K must be half the perimeter of this disk, which is πw as the theorem states.
